using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        // We will create a derived class to override dependencies for testing
        private class TestMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            public Func<object, Task<bool>> CheckConnectionAsyncOverride;
            public Func<Task<string>> SetSlotRangeOverride;
            public Action ResetLocalSlotOverride;
            public ILogger LoggerOverride;

            public TestMigrateSession()
            {
                // Setup default no-op overrides
                CheckConnectionAsyncOverride = _ => Task.FromResult(true);
                SetSlotRangeOverride = () => Task.FromResult("OK");
                ResetLocalSlotOverride = () => { };
                LoggerOverride = null;
            }

            protected override Task<bool> CheckConnectionAsync(object client)
            {
                return CheckConnectionAsyncOverride(client);
            }

            protected override Task<string> ClientSetSlotRangeAsync()
            {
                return SetSlotRangeOverride();
            }

            protected override void ResetLocalSlot()
            {
                ResetLocalSlotOverride();
            }

            protected override ILogger Logger => LoggerOverride;
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsTraceOnSuccess()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var session = new TestMigrateSession
            {
                LoggerOverride = loggerMock.Object
            };

            // Setup CheckConnectionAsync to return true
            session.CheckConnectionAsyncOverride = _ => Task.FromResult(true);

            // Setup SetSlotRange to return "OK"
            session.SetSlotRangeOverride = () => Task.FromResult("OK");

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Completed] SETSLOT")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;
using System.Threading;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using Moq;
using Xunit;
using Garnet.cluster;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    public class MigrateSessionTests
    {
        // We cannot instantiate MigrateSession directly because it is internal sealed partial.
        // We will test TrySetSlotRangesAsync by subclassing a testable wrapper class in the same namespace.
        // Since we cannot modify the original code, we will test the logging behavior by mocking ILogger and dependencies.

        // We create a minimal testable subclass in the test namespace to expose TrySetSlotRangesAsync for testing.
        private class TestableMigrateSession : MigrateSession
        {
            public TestableMigrateSession(ILogger logger, Func<object, Task<bool>> checkConnectionAsync, Func<Task<string>> setSlotRangeAsync)
            {
                this.logger = logger;
                this._checkConnectionAsync = checkConnectionAsync;
                this._setSlotRangeAsync = setSlotRangeAsync;
                this.Status = MigrateState.PENDING;
                this._timeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1);
                this._cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
                this.migrateOperation = new[] { new MigrateOperationMock() };
                this._sslots = new int[0];
                this._slotRanges = new int[0];
            }

            private readonly ILogger logger;
            private readonly Func<object, Task<bool>> _checkConnectionAsync;
            private readonly Func<Task<string>> _setSlotRangeAsync;

            // Expose Status for test assertions
            public new MigrateState Status { get; set; }

            // Expose _timeout and _cts for test
            public new TimeSpan _timeout { get; set; }
            public new CancellationTokenSource _cts { get; set; }

            // Expose migrateOperation for test
            public new MigrateOperationMock[] migrateOperation { get; set; }

            // Expose _sslots and _slotRanges for test
            public new int[] _sslots { get; set; }
            public new int[] _slotRanges { get; set; }

            protected override Task<bool> CheckConnectionAsync(object client)
            {
                return _checkConnectionAsync(client);
            }

            protected override Task<string> ClientSetSlotRangeAsync()
            {
                return _setSlotRangeAsync();
            }

            // We override the client property to return a dummy object
            public class MigrateOperationMock
            {
                public object Client => new object();
            }

            // We override ClusterManager.GetRange to return a fixed string for testing
            public static class ClusterManager
            {
                public static string GetRange(int[] slots) => "slot-range";
            }
        }

        [Fact]
        public async Task TrySetSlotRangesAsync_LogsTraceOnSuccess()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var session = new TestableMigrateSession(
                loggerMock.Object,
                checkConnectionAsync: _ => Task.FromResult(true),
                setSlotRangeAsync: () => Task.FromResult("OK")
            );

            // Act
            var result = await session.TrySetSlotRangesAsync("node1", MigrateState.STABLE);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(result);
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);

            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("[Completed] SETSLOT")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}

using System;

using Moq;
using Xunit;

namespace Garnet.Tests.cluster
{
    // We cannot access internal sealed MigrateSession or MigrateState directly.
    // Instead, we test the ILogger extension method LogTrace usage by creating a minimal ILogger mock and calling it directly.
    // This test will verify that the LogTrace extension method is called with expected message and parameters.

    public class LoggerExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void LogTrace_ExtensionMethod_CalledWithExpectedMessage()
        {
            // Arrange
            var loggerMock = new Mock<ILogger>();
            var state = "STABLE";
            var nodeid = "node1";
            var slots = "slot-range";

            // Act
            loggerMock.Object.LogTrace("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE {state} {nodeid} {slots}", state, nodeid, slots);

            // Assert
            loggerMock.Verify(
                x => x.Log(
                    LogLevel.Trace,
                    It.IsAny<EventId>(),
                    It.Is<It.IsAnyType>((v, t) => v.ToString().Contains("Sending CLUSTER SETSLOTRANGE")),
                    null,
                    It.IsAny<Func<It.IsAnyType, Exception, string>>()),
                Times.Once);
        }
    }
}
